prompt: Keep the exact same camera, framing, walls, house, pear tree, stone post, gate, path, sundial and lantern, in the same places and sizes. Change the sky to a deep violet dusk with no golden sun and a few pale stars, and make the light and every shadow cool violet and plum. Replace the pink flowers in the raised beds with tall violet star-lilies, one kind only, in neat straight rows. The stone bench under the tree becomes straight, clean and upright, with no stain. Hang a plain wooden garden swing from a low branch of the pear tree, its ropes tied together with a neat bow. Remove the wheelbarrow and the watering can. Everything perfectly still and tidy: no wind, no fallen leaves, no people, no animals, no text or letters anywhere.
